Container.Name: Platen
Container.Overview: Self-hosted photo and video backup with automatic upload from iOS and Android, a justified timeline, albums, public share links and optional CLIP-powered natural-language search. Requires a Postgres 17 database with the pgvector extension.
Container.Requires: A Postgres 17 container with pgvector (image: pgvector/pgvector:pg17).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface and the mobile app API.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Where original photos and videos are stored. Put this on the array and include it in your backup plan.

Config.Name: Thumbnails
Config.Description: Generated thumbnails and previews. Regenerable, so cache/SSD is ideal and it does not need backing up.

Config.Name: Upload temp
Config.Description: In-flight uploads. Ideally on the same filesystem as the library, so finished uploads are a rename rather than a copy.

Config.Name: ML model cache
Config.Description: Cached CLIP weights (about 250 MB), so they are downloaded only once.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Connection string for the pgvector-enabled Postgres container.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign login tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Changing it signs everyone out.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: The URL your phone uses to reach this server. Must be reachable from your devices, not just from the Unraid host.

Config.Name: ALLOW_REGISTRATION
Config.Description: Allow anyone who can reach the server to create an account. Leave false and invite people from Settings instead.

Config.Name: ENABLE_ML
Config.Description: Natural-language photo search. Set false on low-power hardware to skip the model download and the CPU cost of indexing.

Config.Name: JOB_CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: How many thumbnails or embeddings to process at once. Roughly one per CPU core you are willing to give it.

Config.Name: TRASH_RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: How long deleted photos stay recoverable in the trash before the files are removed.

Config.Name: REDIS_URL
Config.Description: Optional thumbnail cache, e.g. redis://platen-redis:6379. Caches only regenerable thumbnails, never your originals or the database. Leave blank to serve everything from disk.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. Capture times come from each photo's own EXIF, so this only affects log timestamps.
